# Welcome to the Unknown.
The Unknown Field (MINE) Guide (Vol. 0) is a 32-page interactive puzzle
zine. Officially, it is a pristine 1950s tourist brochure. Unofficially, it has been
stolen, vandalised, and "corrected" by the punk gang Team Rabbit.
We don't just print books. We forge artefacts. Secure your physical copy today.
Loading Store...
## High Value. Low Volume. Direct to Reader.
3minsto9 is an independent micro-press and immersive media studio based in Wendover, UK.
We operate as Comicsmiths and
Puzzlesmiths . Our mission is to bridge the gap between
graphic novels, Alternate Reality Games, and tactile, high-quality physical media. You
aren't just reading a story; you are stepping into a labyrinth.

#
The Studio.
Independent Micro-Press & Immersive Media.
## Forging Artefacts
Based in Wendover, UK, 3minsto9 operates outside the traditional
publishing machine. Our philosophy is simple:
High Value. Low Volume. Direct to Reader.
We do not believe in disposable media or algorithm-chasing content. We believe in creating
tactile, dangerous physical media that respects the intelligence of our audience. We build
"In-World Artefacts"—books and zines that feel like they have been smuggled out of an
alternate reality, surviving riots and corporate censorship to reach your hands.
"You aren't just reading a story. You are stepping into a labyrinth."
## Our Protocols
Our studio functions through two highly disciplined design methodologies that bridge the
gap between graphic novels and Alternate Reality Games (ARGs).
### The Comicsmith Protocol
We approach visual storytelling with architectural precision. Our projects feature highly
detailed, "Where's Wally" style cross-sections and raw, DIY punk aesthetics. By employing
a strict layering rule with our freelance illustrators, we ensure that the sterile,
corporate background of the world can be aggressively "vandalised" by our characters,
creating an interactive canvas rather than just a picture.
### The Puzzlesmith Protocol
We gamify the page. 3minsto9 books are designed to be played, not just read. We turn our
readers into active detectives by embedding a multi-tiered meta-puzzle layer—dubbed "The
Game of Unknown"—directly into the art and text. From cyphers hidden in the legal
copyright pages to physical code wheels and deductive grids, every detail is a functional
mechanic.
We don't use standard "Art By..." credit pages, because that ruins the illusion. Instead,
our artists hide their personal signatures as "red herring" puzzles within the dense
clutter of the artwork itself.
&copy; 2026 3minsto9 Operations. Wendover, UK. All rights reserved. Do not copy. We do
what we want. | Media Kit

# Frequently Asked Questions
## About the Studio
What is 3minsto9?
+
3minsto9 is an independent micro-press and immersive media studio based in Wendover,
UK. We operate as Comicsmiths and Puzzlesmiths, forging high-value, low-volume
physical artefacts.
Why physical media?
+
We believe in creating tactile, dangerous physical media that respects the
intelligence of our audience. Our books feel like they have been smuggled out of an
alternate reality.
Where are you located?
+
We are based in Wendover, UK, operating directly to our readers without traditional
middlemen.
## Ordering & Shipping
How long does shipping take?
+
Shipping times vary depending on the destination and the artefact. Domestic orders
typically arrive within 3-5 business days.
Do you ship internationally?
+
Yes, we ship globally. Customs and import duties may apply depending on your location.
Can I pre-order?
+
Yes, joining our Dispatch newsletter is the best way to receive pre-order alerts and
secure early drops.
## Puzzle Mechanics
How do I solve the puzzles?
+
Every detail could be a functional mechanic. You might need to decipher codes, find
hidden signatures, or manipulate physical components of the book.
Is there a difficulty level?
+
Our puzzles range from accessible entry-level mysteries to multi-tiered, complex
meta-puzzles embedded in the artwork and text.
Are there spoiler guides?
+
We encourage community collaboration, but official spoiler guides are highly
classified and may require their own puzzle-solving to access.
## Accessibility
Are puzzles screen-reader friendly?
+
We are constantly working to make our digital puzzle elements accessible, though some
physical mechanics rely on visual or tactile inspection. Digital counterparts with
alt-text are provided where possible.
Do you offer alternative formats?
+
Currently, our core experience is physical, but we are exploring audio and
screen-reader optimized digital versions of our narratives.
What about color blindness?
+
Our graphic design generally relies on high contrast and distinct shapes, ensuring
that colour alone is not the only vector for solving a puzzle.
### Join the Dispatch
Sign up to receive pre-order alerts, exclusive Kickstarter intel, and secure puzzle drops.

# Media Resources
Everything journalists, reviewers, and publications need to cover 3minsto9.
## About 3minsto9
3minsto9 is an independent micro-press and immersive media studio based in Wendover, UK.
Founded in 2024, we operate as Comicsmiths and Puzzlesmiths, bridging the gap between
graphic novels, Alternate Reality Games, and tactile, high-quality physical media.
"High Value. Low Volume. Direct to Reader."
## Key Facts
### Founded & Location
Founded in 2024. Based in Wendover, United Kingdom.
### Studio Type
Independent Micro-Press & Immersive Media Studio.
### Mission
Bridge graphic novels, ARGs, and tactile physical media.
### Approach
Comicsmiths + Puzzlesmiths protocols.

# How 3minsto9 Puzzles Work
Understanding the Comicsmith Protocol and Puzzlesmith Protocol
### Comicsmith Protocol
Detailed cross-sections and vandalism layers create an interactive canvas.
Where's Wally style complexity
Raw, DIY punk aesthetics
Sterile corporate background + aggressive character vandalism
Creates friction between "official" and "vandal" narratives
### Puzzlesmith Protocol
Multi-tiered meta-puzzle layer called "The Game of Unknown".
Ciphers hidden in copyright pages
Physical code wheels and deductive grids
Readers become active detectives
Functional mechanics embedded in art and text
## What's a Meta-Puzzle?
A meta-puzzle is a puzzle that uses the solutions or elements of other, smaller puzzles
to reveal a hidden, overarching message. In our books, you might find several standalone
ciphers or riddles that, once solved, provide the pieces needed to unlock a larger
mystery hidden within the narrative framework.
Example from "The Unknown Field Guide" (Vol. 0):
In Vol. 0, a 1950s-style tourist brochure was "corrupted" by Team Rabbit
graffiti. Hidden code in margin notes, when decoded, reveals classified MLTK data.
Readers must determine what is "official" brochure content vs.
"vandal" clues.
See an example puzzle walkthrough
&#9660;
Step 1: The Setup
You find a seemingly innocuous list of "Recommended Hotels" in the brochure.
Step 2: The Clue
Team Rabbit has crossed out certain letters in the hotel names using a specific
color of red ink.
Step 3: The Deduction
By reading only the crossed-out letters in order, you spell out a URL leading to a
hidden page on the MLTK Surveillance Dashboard.
Step 4: The Reward
Accessing the dashboard reveals a downloadable file containing backstory on a key
character.
## How to Read the Layers
01
### Spot the Vandalism Layer
Look for Team Rabbit tags, unnatural color differences, or out-of-place text.
02
### Identify the Mechanic
Determine the type of puzzle: code wheel, logic grid, or cipher key.
03
### Work the Deduction
Gather the pieces and research what the puzzle is asking of you.
04
### Reveal the Hidden Connection
Apply your solution to unlock lore, hidden websites, or real-world drops.
## Difficulty Levels
### Easy
Pick-the-answer puzzles, visual riddles, simple ciphers. Newcomers welcome.
### Medium
Multi-step deductions, research required, code wheels, pattern recognition.
### Hard
Cross-book references, encrypted messages, requires external resources (ARG wikis,
codebreaking tools).
### Expert
Hidden meta-narrative, requires community collaboration, leads to real-world events or
drops.
## Community Resources
Puzzles are meant to be solved together. No spoilers without warning!
Join the Community Discord
Browse the Fan Puzzle Wiki
Read Puzzle Walkthroughs
## Frequently Asked Questions
### Can I solve puzzles solo?
Yes, but community collaboration often reveals hidden layers and makes the experience
richer.
### Is there a "correct" solution?
The meta-puzzle has objective answers, but the interpretation of the lore and
narrative is personal.
### What if I get stuck?
Check the community wiki, post on Discord, or email us for hints. We want you to
succeed!

# Privacy Policy
Last updated: [Current Date]
## 1. Information We Collect
We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, and IP address when
you interact with our website, sign up for our newsletter, or contact us. We also collect
non-personal information through cookies and similar technologies to improve user
experience.
## 2. How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to operate and maintain our website, communicate with you,
analyze website usage, and provide you with information or services you request.
## 3. Information Sharing
We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personally identifiable information to
outside parties without your consent, except to trusted third parties who assist us in
operating our website or conducting our business, so long as those parties agree to keep
this information confidential.
## 4. Data Security
We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal
information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is
100% secure.
## 5. Your Rights
You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. If you wish to
exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
## 6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by
posting the new privacy policy on this page.
## 7. Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [Contact Email].

TO: Virtue Village Administrative Block Supervisors (Sectors A–M)
FROM: Avery Hectare, Executive Director of Cognitive Audits & Optimization
DATE: [000.00.00] // MANDATORY COMPLIANCE CYCLE
SUBJECT: Linguistic Contamination & Unauthorized Signal Bleed in Sector 4
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. AUDIT FINDINGS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A routine sweep of the Administrative Block (O-Piece Block 04, Village of
Determinedly) has uncovered severe breaches of the Refined Lexicon protocol.
Multiple "Smurf" clerks were logged utilizing unauthorized "Their There"
street slang—specifically recorded uttering terms including "groovy,"
"daddy-o," "innit," and "bogus" into municipal acoustic horns.
Pursuant to MLTK Terms of Service §3 (Utilization Protocols), linguistic purity
is required to maintain structural harmony across the Cartridge Estates.
The offending personnel have been detained for postural integrity realignment
at Have Faith In Solid.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. EQUIPMENT ANOMALY & FREQUENCY NOTCH
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
During biometric logging, compliance enforcers confiscated non-sanctioned
analogue media, including a modified transistor unit with an altered tuner dial.
Signal diagnostics registered a persistent radio-frequency hum bleeding
through municipal infrastructure at precisely 104.9 MHz.
While supervisors dismissed this as background atmospheric static from the
Mini Rail power grid, analytical modeling indicates a structured, repeating
audio carrier wave.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. DIRECTIVE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Inspect all desk drawers for unauthorized analogue components, rubber poultry
items, or mismatched novelty footwear. Any employee caught adjusting
telecommunications equipment to the 104.9 sub-bandwidth will face immediate
contract termination and transfer to Re-education Center B under Project
Tetromino parameters.

right down the laundry chute. Stay messy. Stay loud."

CLASSIFICATION: HIGH-PRIORITY // RESTRICTED ACCESS
================================================================================
TO: Regional Operations Managers, Seedless Grapes Motel Network
FROM: Avery Hectare, Executive Director of Cognitive Audits & Optimization
DATE: [000.00.00] // MANDATORY COMPLIANCE CYCLE
SUBJECT: Seizure of Modified Audio Hardware & Rogue Pirate Transmissions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. INCIDENT SUMMARY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Night-shift personnel across eight Seedless Grapes Motels have been observed
intentionally bypassing internal audio censors during duty cycles. In the Village
of Inspiringly, two junior clerks were caught listening to an illegal audio feed
broadcasting low-budget satirical space-opera serials ("Captain Overhere")
interspersed with unapproved jazz and extreme metal tracks.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. TELEMETRY TRACE & CYPHER KEY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Subterranean spectrum analysis confirms the source of this auditory disruption
is an unsanctioned, mobile pirate transmitter operating out of the Town of
There border hexes. The transmission centers on 104.9 FM. This specific
frequency (104.9 FM) appears to be utilized by rogue elements as an unauthorized
cypher key to decrypt underlying administrative telemetry.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. SANCTIONS & CORRECTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
All Seedless Grapes Motel room radios must have their physical tuning dials
mechanically welded to prevent manual frequency selection.
- Failure to log unauthorized audio activity: -15 Favour penalty.
- Active tuning to 104.9 FM: Immediate surrender of biometric data and
relocation to Sub-Level C4 containment.

flawed.

Dev Blog
October 24, 2026
# Architecting the Unknown: Behind the Scenes of Vol. 0
Welcome to the first entry of our developer blog. As we continue to blur the lines
between physical artefacts and digital experiences, we wanted a space to discuss the
technical and creative hurdles of building an Alternate Reality Game (ARG) layered
beneath a traditional indie publishing facade.
When we set out to create The Unknown Field Guide , the primary
challenge wasn't just writing the narrative; it was designing the architecture that
would allow players to organically discover the hidden layers of the story.
### The Physical-Digital Bridge
Our physical zine is pristine, meant to look like a 1950s tourist brochure. But the
real magic happens when players notice the "corrections" scribbled in the margins by
Team Rabbit. These corrections are more than just flavor text—they are breadcrumbs
leading to our digital infrastructure.
Building a robust, un-gameable backend that still feels like a vulnerable, compromised
corporate intranet (MLTK) has been a fascinating exercise in contradictory design. We
have to build secure systems that pretend to be insecure.
September 15, 2026

Privacy Policy & Terms - MLTK Corporation
## MLTK Corporation // Global Data Operations
CONFIDENTIALITY IS MANDATORY
# Privacy "Policy" & Terms of Service
Effective Date: [000.00.00] //
MANDATORY COMPLIANCE
## 1. TERMS OF SERVICE
By accessing any MLTK Corporation system, terminal, or physical facility, you agree to be
bound by these Terms of Service. You are authorized to use MLTK systems solely for
official, sanctioned business.
MLTK Corporation reserves the right to terminate access, employment, and potentially
physical existence for any violations of these terms, including unauthorized access to
classified materials (e.g., Project Tetromino).
## 2. DATA ASSIMILATION
By interfacing with MLTK systems, the City of Everywhere infrastructure, or any affiliated
network node, you hereby surrender all rights, claims, and expectations of privacy
regarding your digital footprint, biometric data, neuro-kinetic patterns, and genetic
sequencing metadata.
We do not "collect" data; we integrate it.
## 3. UTILIZATION PROTOCOLS
Your assimilated data will be utilized for:
- Optimization of the Virtue Villages.
- Identification and neutralization of dissenting frequencies (e.g., TEAM RABBIT).
- Predictive behavioral modeling to ensure absolute compliance with Corporate
Director G. Meredith's directives.
-
[CLASSIFIED PROJECT NOVA EXPLOITATION] .
## 4. DATA DISSEMINATION
MLTK Corporation does not sell your data. Your data is MLTK property. We share it solely
with internal security forces, automated algorithmic enforcers, and authorized tier-4
personnel to maintain operational harmony within the City of Everywhere.
## 5. SECURITY APPARATUS
Your data is secured by proprietary Quantum ICE protocols. Any attempt to encrypt,
obfuscate, or withhold mandatory telemetry will be classified as an act of cyber-sedition
and met with immediate physical quarantine measures.
## 6. YOUR "RIGHTS"
Citizens of the City of Everywhere possess the right to continued existence, contingent
upon consistent data output. Requests for data deletion are computationally impossible and
philosophically discouraged.
## 7. AMENDMENTS
MLTK Corporation reserves the right to alter these terms retrospectively. Notification
will not be provided. Ignorance of the updated policy is not a valid defense during
Tribunal proceedings.
## 8. CONTACT
Do not contact us regarding this policy. Our automated systems are already monitoring your
emotional response to reading this document. Have a productive cycle.
